title: Built-in Panel views: the originals under the Panel Lucs
summary: The editor's own views for the six Panel modules (outline, tasks, files, library, Skill Space, properties). They are what a module shows when no Panel Luc carries it, when a contained Panel is missing, and when an Official Panel fails. A module a Panel Luc draws goes by the Panel's name; when the Panel fails, the built-in view comes back under its own name.

carrier.notes: refreshPanel in static/v3/v3.js chooses the Panel or the built-in view for each module.

replaceability.why: They are the floor the iron rule falls back to for Panels: a broken Panel ends here. A Panel Luc replaces one by drawing on top of it, never by removing it.
replaceability.decided: self-Luc inventory 2.7 and row 96 (already the original-under-a-layer shape); docs/luc/self-luc-inventory.md:96

reach.notes: They are the editor itself and read through the editor's own Runtime routes.
